# `b10x-sandbox`

Generated by `sandbox-docs` from the clap definition in [`src/cli.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/sandbox/blob/main/src/cli.rs). `b10x-sandbox --version` prints the version and `b10x-sandbox --help` prints the same text.

> Respawn the current shell inside a bubblewrap sandbox. The working directory is bound writable at /workspace. With --dir, the common ancestor of the working directory and every --dir becomes /workspace and each directory is bound at its path relative to that ancestor; nothing in between is visible. No network unless --net.

```text
Usage: b10x-sandbox [OPTIONS] [CMD]...
```

## Options

| Option | Repeatable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir <PATH>` | yes | none | A host directory to bind writable, mirrored under /workspace. Repeatable. |
| `--ro <PATH>` | yes | none | A host directory to bind read-only at its own path, such as a toolchain home. Repeatable. |
| `--net` | no | none | Keep the host network namespace. |
| `--backend <BACKEND>` | no | `bubblewrap` | Which program confines the process. One of `bubblewrap`, `docker`. |
| `--image <NAME>` | no | `debian:stable-slim` | The image for --backend docker. |
| `--allow-tiocsti` | no | none | Run even when `dev.tty.legacy_tiocsti` is 1. |
| `--dry-run` | no | none | Print the program and its argv, one argument per line, and exit without running it. |
| `[CMD]...` | no | none | The command to run. Default: $SHELL (or /bin/sh when unset) under bubblewrap, /bin/sh under docker, where the image decides which shells exist. |

## Exit status

Under `--dry-run`, 0 after printing the argument list. Otherwise the process is replaced by the backend's program, so the exit status is the sandboxed command's (as `bwrap` or `docker run` report it). A refusal before that point — an input path the layout refuses, a missing backend program, `dev.tty.legacy_tiocsti` set to 1 — prints `b10x-sandbox: <reason>` on stderr and exits 2. Clap's own usage errors also exit 2.
